title: The Blood Spiral (book)

full_text:
The Blood Spiral (titled La Spirale di Sangue in Italy) was a novel written by Frank J. Martucci based on Season 2 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. It had been planned to be published by Fabbri Editori on 1st June 2010 but was ultimately never released.

== Synopsis ==
